authorization_and_scope: Root explicitly authorized compact current narratives for terminal human-written observation notes while retaining all actual conclusions, source/parameter/run/error/unknown obligations and whole originals at fixed Git.
All six original note bodies were obtained as complete text after metadata checks; each is below 100000 bytes.
This is in-place documentation consolidation. No path is deleted. Every original non-JSON narrative segment, table, formula, chronology, original link, failure and unknown is retained verbatim.

Exactly 119 fenced JSON blocks are replaced by individually numbered links to the complete old file and exact original line range. No numerical delta encoding, partial JSON pretending to be complete, scientific payload upload, truncated input or network-event replay is introduced.

A new terminal guide distinguishes later terminal evidence from each earlier section's time-dependent prepared/running/null state. Statements that the original JSON appears below now explicitly refer to the adjacent complete historical link.

Canonical source, proof, request, queue, workflow, ready, exact input, accepted/final checkpoint, numerical report and active-run material are untouched. The three independent run19/run21 evidence notes are retained byte for byte.
The six original complete notes are recoverable at the declared fixed public commit and exact blob/bytes/SHA256; no claim that an official historical API event can be re-run is made.

historical_reader_contract.other_links: Human links to the six current paths obtain the complete original prose plus exact full-record references. Other previously issued source/provenance whole records keep their original version identity and must resolve that whole version; this package does not assert absence of additional historical consumers.
historical_reader_contract.complete_old_recovery: In an isolated checkout with the fixed commit available, use git show <complete_original_restore_commit>:<original_complete_file.path>. Verify the declared whole bytes/SHA256/Git blob when an old reader requires that version. Never silently substitute the new current narrative for an old hash.

complete_text_reproducer.reads: Only the six complete historical Markdown notes, by exact git show commit:path; no scientific arrays or executable mathematical module is opened or invoked.
complete_text_reproducer.writes: Six complete current Markdown notes under the new output directory; no checkout/ref mutation.
complete_text_reproducer.inverse: The implementation removes only its own added guide and restores every exact original fenced JSON block, then requires string equality with the whole original. This was performed as source-text construction, not scientific execution or a new run gate.
